text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx and cross-region timeouts affecting api.redwood.ai — detected in us-east-1 and eu-west-1. Auto-posting to #incidents.
laura_oncall: I'm on pager. starting immediate triage.
laura_oncall: Quick snapshot: ELB/errors: us-east-1 shows rapid 502/504 spike; health-check fail count increasing on a subset of backend hosts (host-azb-*). CPU/GPU metrics look normal.
priya_sre: I see Route53 health-checks toggling for the us-east record and low TTL (30s). Also our internal lb shows backend marked unhealthy from src 10.0.0.0/16 only.
tom_net: Rolling logs from our peering links show BGP withdraws and path changes at ~2024-07-02T09:12Z for the us-east prefixes. Provider has a known control-plane event. Opening provider ticket now (REF: CP-8341).
jules_support: Getting surge in customer tickets about timeouts and "model not responding" errors. Top accounts affected: acct-4512, acct-77, acct-9001. Triage team alerted.
laura_oncall: Can we confirm it's not a code/regression? deploy-bot: No active full region deploys in last hour; small canary pushed 20m ago (commit d4e9f). No rollback.
priya_sre: App logs show upstream connect errors from edge NGINX: 
```
2024-07-02T09:14:05Z ERROR upstream connect error or disconnect upstream, host=10.12.48.78
```
This points to network connectivity between edge and backend pool.
tom_net: Provider status page shows "peering instability" and a partial fabric isolate in us-east-1b. They're rerouting but some sessions time out.
laura_oncall: Proposed mitigation: 1) Drain traffic from affected AZ (us-east-1b). 2) Shift traffic weight to us-east-1a and us-west-2 in controlled increments. 3) Increase autoscale burst for receiving regions and prime caches. Any objections?
priya_sre: +1. Also add a pre-warm step: spin additional worker pods and run a small priming job for the embedding cache before increasing traffic.
jules_support: I'll prepare a customer advisory note on status.redwood.ai after we confirm mitigation started.
laura_oncall: Executing drain: `infractl drain-az --region us-east-1 --az b --grace 90s`
ops-bot: Drain job created: drain-20240702-09:20 (status: running). Estimated drain time 3m.
laura_oncall: Initiating weight shift to us-west-2 at 25%: `rctl set-edge-weight --from us-east-1b --to us-west-2 --weight 25`
priya_sre: ELB weights adjusted. Noting clients with long-lived connections still hitting old AZ due to DNS/connection persistence.
tom_net: Also confirming CDN origin entries pointing to old edge IPs; issuing cache purge for edge-origin mappings.
laura_oncall: After shift, saw initial drop in errors to ~7% global, but us-west-2 p95 increased. Likely cold-starts + cache miss. Bumping autoscale pool: `autoscale update --pool us-west-2 --min 30 --max 140`
priya_sre: Running priming job: `jobctl run priming --targets us-west-2 --keys 500` — priming embeddings and KV cache.
jules_support: Customer impact estimate: roughly 12% of requests during peak window experienced errors/timeouts. High-touch customers notified directly.
laura_oncall: Noted provider says they'll continue partial routing around the affected fabric. They advise keeping weights reduced for 90m to avoid oscillation.
priya_sre: Observed a weird behavior: session-affinity headers were lost when traffic crossed AZ due to asymmetric return paths; this caused some upstream clusters to reject requests. Adding sticky-cookie fallback for the failover window.
laura_oncall: Rolling back weight to 10% to reduce error rate while priming completes: `rctl set-edge-weight --from us-east-1b --to us-west-2 --weight 10`
ops-bot: Weight change recorded: job-2121 SUCCESS.
laura_oncall: PD created PD-4922, severity: high. Handoff incoming in 40m.
tom_net: Provider update: "Control plane has partial stabilization; BGP withdrawals decreasing. Recommend staged traffic resumption and proactive cache/warm steps."
priya_sre: Next steps: 1) Keep AZ drained until provider confirms fabric healthy; 2) finish cache priming; 3) monitor error-rate and tail latency; 4) schedule RCA and runbook updates. I'll take lead after laura's handoff.
jules_support: Status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/PD-4922 with brief summary and next update ETA 30m.
laura_oncall: Handoff note -> owner: priya_sre. Key points: PD-4922 open, us-east-1b drained, partial traffic shift (10%), priming job running, watch metrics: 5xx_rate, p95_latency, tickets from acct-4512/acct-77.
priya_sre: Taking over. I will update the channel every 15m. Scheduling RCA meeting for 2024-07-03T11:00Z. Runbook follow-ups: add pre-warm, DNS TTL play, and sticky session mitigation.
jules_support: Marking tickets as incident-related and routing to solutions teams for outreach. Drafting customer follow-up message for 60m.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity downgraded to degraded, affected zones: us-east-1b (drained), mitigation: partial traffic shift + priming.
priya_sre: Provider message at 09:58Z: "Routing fabric returned to stable state for most customers; if you continue to see issues please report." We'll keep AZ drained 1hr and then slowly reintroduce if stable.
laura_oncall: Thanks team. Ending my active on-call handover. If regression, page PD-4922 and ping me. Good work. :thumbsup:
priya_sre: Monitoring only. I'll post the post-incident timeline and actions after the RCA.
jules_support: Final note: support callbacks scheduled to impacted accounts and status page updated with postmortem link placeholder.
priya_sre: Closing thread for active ops; keeping it open for RCA artifact uploads. :white_check_mark:
